lede: Hock Eng Automobile Workshop is a car workshop in Bedok Industrial Park E. Its own website lists car servicing, repairs, aircon repair and servicing and engine services.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention clear explanations, transparent pricing with no upselling and quick turnaround, often within a day. Several note it opens on Sundays and that the team speaks English, Mandarin and Cantonese.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, hockengauto.com.
makes_note: Named by customers on Google Maps. Ask the workshop about other makes.
good_to_know: Enquiries by WhatsApp, according to its website
